summary: Iteration 3 (Life Graph Core) tested end-to-end. Backend: 34/35 pytest cases pass (97.1%). All 32 Life Graph scenarios (A–F) pass: vocabulary + idempotent seed, node CRUD with soft-archive/include_archived, edge creation + validation (same-endpoint 400, missing-node 404), BFS neighborhood at depths 1 and 2, decision <-> node link/unlink with idempotent $addToSet and history events (life_graph.linked / life_graph.unlinked), cascade on archive (edges deleted + decision.node_ids stripped), auth guards (401 without token), and cross-user isolation (user B sees user A nodes as 404). Regression untouched: /decisions/top ordering, /decisions/{id}/resolve real GPT-5.2 call, complete/dismiss, legacy /priorities and /tasks, memory add + memory/ask, auth error codes (409/401). Frontend regression G passes 100%: login via login-email-button CTA + login-submit-button, Home shows ORA brand + 'Cosa conta adesso' + 3 cards with priority-reason-N + home-show-more-button; RISOLVI (priority-resolve-0) opens resolve-modal, resolve-solution-text returns real Italian solution, resolve-done-button closes modal; bottom tabs Memoria/Aggiungi/Profilo navigable; profile-logout-button returns to login. Only failure is a PRE-EXISTING stale-seed issue on demo user (top-1 reason_tags = ['deadline_24h'] instead of ['imminent']) — the seeded 'Esci tra 25 minuti' starts_at was set relative to first-seed time and has since expired. Not caused by iteration 3.

minor.issue: Pre-existing seed drift: 'Esci tra 25 minuti' seed uses absolute starts_at set at first seed. After time passes, its 'imminent' reason_tag disappears and top-1 shifts to the deadline_24h exam. Not an iteration 3 regression. Fresh users still get 'imminent'.

action_items: Optional (not blocking iteration 3): re-run demo user seed with dynamic starts_at, or offset seed timestamps at login time, so the 'imminent' 25-min task remains imminent for the long-lived demo account.

Doc nit: review request references testID 'login-email-button' for logging in with credentials — the actual submit is 'login-submit-button' (login-email-button is only the CTA that opens the email form). Update playbook wording to avoid future ambiguity.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 715 lines and mixes auth, decisions, legacy tasks, life graph, memory. Splitting into routers/{auth,decisions,life_graph,memory}.py would improve maintainability but not urgent.
life_graph/service.py cleanly excludes _id via projections and normalizes unknown types to 'generic' — good.
archive_node cascade is atomic-ish (3 sequential Mongo ops, no transaction). Acceptable for personal graph size; document if consistency is critical.
seed_data_creation: Two fresh users registered per run (lifegraph_a_<ts>@ora.app, lifegraph_b_<ts>@ora.app). Each triggers decision seed on register and Life Graph seed via POST /api/life-graph/seed. Tests are self-contained (no manual cleanup needed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run tests with `-n 0` (serial), NOT `-p no:xdist` — pytest.ini forces `-n 2 --dist loadscope` which errors when xdist is disabled. Tests share module-level STATE dict across classes so parallel execution splits state across workers and everything after class 1 fails. The one demo-user failure (test_27) is not an iteration 3 bug; ignore unless demo seed is rebuilt with dynamic timestamps.
rca_of_issue: test_27 root cause: /app/backend/decision_engine/service.py build_seed_decisions() sets starts_at for 'Esci tra 25 minuti' relative to seed time (created_at). The demo@ora.app account was seeded once (at 2026-07-30T13:34:41Z per DB history) and has never been reseeded. Its starts_at is now in the past, so the reason engine no longer emits the 'imminent' tag and the exam (deadline_24h) becomes top-1 by score. Mitigation: (a) rerun seed on this user after wiping decisions, or (b) shift seeded timestamps into the near future on every login for demo accounts.
